messages.content: 你能先幫我找一個素食，主菜的食譜嗎？並且能在30分鐘內準備好嗎？之後，能否請你找出重力的科學發現的詳細資料，使用預設的方法？完成後，我也想知道使用同樣方法發現希格斯玻色子的相關資料。最後，能否幫我找一個能在45分鐘內準備的無麩質甜點食譜？

function.name: find_recipe
function.description: Find a recipe based on the dietary restrictions, recipe type, and time constraints. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

dietary_restrictions.description: Dietary restrictions e.g. vegan, vegetarian, gluten free, dairy free.

recipe_type.description: Type of the recipe. E.g. dessert, main course, breakfast.

time.description: Time limit in minutes to prep the meal.

function.name: science_history_get_discovery_details
function.description: Retrieve the details of a scientific discovery based on the discovery name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

discovery.description: The name of the discovery, e.g. Gravity

method_used.description: The method used for the discovery, default value is 'default' which gives the most accepted method.

message.reasoning:
The user wants:

1) A vegetarian main dish within 30 min.

2) Details about gravity using default method.

3) Related info about Higgs boson discovered with same method (likely LHC).

4) Gluten-free dessert within 45 min.

We need to call two functions: find_recipe twice; science_history_get_discovery_details twice? Actually we can get both discoveries via separate calls or maybe one call per discovery. We have no tool to combine multiple queries into single call except calling separately.

Thus plan: Call find_recipe once for first request. Then call science_history_get_discovery_details for "Gravity" with default method. Then call science_history_get_discovery_details for "Higgs Boson". Then call find_recipe again for second recipe.

But note: The user might want us to provide all results after each step. But they said "完成後，我也想知道..." meaning after retrieving gravity details, also know Higgs boson details. So likely sequentially but we can just do them together.

We'll produce four outputs accordingly.

Let's proceed. We'll use the function calls as needed.
